definitions.explanation: A person who distributes content online, especially someone who livestreams video on platforms like YouTube or Twitch. A modern term that has become common with the rise of internet streaming culture.

examples.japanese: {人気|にんき}{配信者|はいしんしゃ}の{動画|どうが}を{見|み}た。
examples.english: I watched a video by a popular streamer.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}はゲーム{配信者|はいしんしゃ}として{活動|かつどう}している。
examples.english: She is active as a game streamer.

examples.japanese: {最近|さいきん}は{配信者|はいしんしゃ}になりたいという{若者|わかもの}が{多|おお}い。
examples.english: Recently, many young people want to become streamers.

notes:
USAGE:
A compound of {配信|はいしん} (distribution, streaming) and {者|しゃ} (person). While {配信|はいしん} can refer to any digital content delivery, {配信者|はいしんしゃ} in modern usage almost exclusively means someone who livestreams or creates online video content. Often shortened to just {配信者|はいしんしゃ} without further qualification.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {人気|にんき}{配信者|はいしんしゃ} (popular streamer)
- ゲーム{配信者|はいしんしゃ} (game streamer)
- {配信者|はいしんしゃ}として{活動|かつどう}する (to be active as a streamer)
- {配信者|はいしんしゃ}デビュー (debut as a streamer)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ストリーマー: streamer — English loanword, used interchangeably
- ユーチューバー: YouTuber — specifically for YouTube creators
